title: Aurora core unblock — the WGSL black-canvas + WebGL2-default-until-parity
restorationWave: AX.W14 (band C · AURORA) — owns the WEBGPU_PARITY flip for the opt-in Kuwahara path

defect_1a_intInFloat.site: aurora.wgsl.ts struct Uniforms — stopCount/nucleiCount/warpMode/noiseOctaves/medium declared i32; uniformBridge.ts packGPUUniforms writes a float into the i32 slot (the `// stopCount (as int-in-float)` comment at :153)
defect_1a_intInFloat.mechanism: WGSL reads the raw 4 bytes of stopCount as i32 → the IEEE-754 bit-pattern of float 3.0 = 1077936128, not the int 3. samplePalette t = id * f32(stopCount-1) ≈ id * 1.07e9 → i0 = i32(floor(t)) overflows the palette bounds → black.
defect_1a_intInFloat.deviceProven: On the AX.W00 real Metal box the live aurora WGSL twin rendered [0,0,0,255]; the bite-check (reverting only the f32-cast, keeping the storage move) re-RED on apple/metal-3 with a BLACK [0,0,0] centre pixel.

defect_1b_uniformDynamicIndex.site: aurora.wgsl.ts — palette/nucleiPos/nucleiMod arrays declared INSIDE struct Uniforms bound `@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> U`; samplePalette (runtime i0/i1) + nucleiField (runtime U.nucleiPos[i] loop) dynamic-index them.
defect_1b_uniformDynamicIndex.mechanism: On Apple/Metal (Tint→MSL) a per-invocation runtime index into a `var<uniform> array<vec4f>` returns [0,0,0,0] (MSL forbids dynamic indexing of the `constant` address space); the IDENTICAL access from `var<storage,read>` reads the real stop. samplePalette + nucleiField sample a zeroed palette → black.
defect_1b_uniformDynamicIndex.deviceProven: Device-proven in W01-aurora-webgpu-blackcanvas.md; the bite-check (reverting only the storage move, keeping the f32-cast, arrays back in var<uniform>) re-RED on apple/metal-3 with a BLACK [0,0,0] centre pixel — proving 1b is load-bearing and NOT redundant.

witness1_blackCanvas_twoDefects.bothRequired: Each defect is independently load-bearing; landing only one still ships black (confirmed by both adversarial bite-checks). They land in ONE atomic shader-struct rewrite (the same commit).

witness2_gatePhilosophyGap.note: Every prior aurora WebGPU gate (proof:aurora-wgsl-equivalence + proof:webgpu-substrate-single + proof:aurora-backend-fallback) is CPU-math / regex / AST — none instantiates a GPUDevice or reads back a pixel. The var<uniform> dynamic-index miscompile + the int-in-float mismatch are invisible to every existing gate BY CONSTRUCTION. The wave adds proof:aurora-webgpu-render — the first GPUDevice render-and-readback gate.

witness3_gatingSeamAbsent.publicUnion: AuroraRenderMode = "webgl" | "css" | "auto" — NO "webgpu" value; WebGPU was selected by the internal resolveRenderModeAsync probe (:119 returned { substrate: "webgpu", device }) with NO consumer opt-out. There was no shared named lever W07 sets false and W14 owns.

fileChanges.change: The atomic struct rewrite: stopCount/nucleiCount/warpMode/noiseOctaves/medium declared f32 + i32()-cast at every read (fbm noiseOctaves, samplePalette stopCount, nucleiField nucleiCount); palette/nucleiPos/nucleiMod moved out of struct Uniforms into a new `struct Field` bound `@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> F` (samplePalette/nucleiField read F.palette/F.nucleiPos/F.nucleiMod). Header comment rewritten (struck the false `uniform arrays → std140 storage struct` description; documents the f32-uniform + storage-field architecture).

packGPUUniforms split-write — signature now (cfg, timeSec, uniformOut, fieldOut): 16 scalars + the 5 now-f32 counts → uniformOut; palette/nuclei vec4 arrays → fieldOut (the storage Field). Struck the `// as int-in-float` comment. WGPU_UNIFORM_FLOATS = 16; new WGPU_FIELD_FLOATS = MAX_STOPS*4 + MAX_NUCLEI*4*2. std140 vec4 stride unchanged (storage-correct).

createGPUAuroraSetup allocates the Field storage buffer (STORAGE|COPY_DST) + a binding-1 bind-group entry (the layout gains the storage binding); the frame writes both buffers. Added a local masterTempo() (getReducedMotion()?0:1) threaded into advanceCursor; shouldContinue now carries the cursor.burst (interactivity.light) + cursorIsLive terms to match frameLoop.needsAnimation. teardown destroys the field buffer.

Added the module-level `export const WEBGPU_PARITY = false` (internal lever, NOT a consumer prop), JSDoc'd as the shared W07↔W14 switch. resolveRenderModeAsync short-circuits to { substrate: "webgl", device: null } before the adapter probe while WEBGPU_PARITY === false (a capable machine never pays requestAdapter for a backend it will not bind).

NEW — the device render-and-readback spec: real GPUDevice + real createGPUAuroraSetup pipeline + real packGPUUniforms; DEFAULT config at t=1; centre-pixel readback (non-black floor), per-i32-field decode (stopCount===3/nucleiCount===2/noiseOctaves===4 + the struct declares the count fields f32), WebGL2-vs-WebGPU base-field luma delta, and the WEBGPU_PARITY-resolves-webgl routing call.

NEW — the proof:aurora-webgpu-render gate driver. Mirrors proof-substrate-paints-color.mjs: spawns the workspace Playwright runner, parses the JSON report, fail-CLOSED on a present-device-renders-black, befitting-silent SKIP on (a) no installed Playwright binary OR (b) all specs internally test.skip'd (navigator.gpu absent — headless Chromium). The two failure modes are never collapsed.
Added the `proof:aurora-webgpu-render` script entry (after proof:webgpu-substrate-single). proof:gate-script-parity bijection GREEN.

Rewrote the WebGPU section: the f32-uniform + storage-field architecture; the WEBGPU_PARITY lever + the WebGL2-default-until-parity KNOWN LIMITATION (the DEGRADED disclosure, AX.W14 named as restoration). Added the proof:aurora-webgpu-render row to the gate table.
